limitations: Original historic publisher/tree/window/shaker photographs, string physical trial, station cards, scale applet, salt-video measurements and protected model answers were not reproduced/verified.

Historic global landmark window counts and weight models are classroom assumptions not verified modern building/workforce/health facts.
